notes: Site: anthropologie.com/en-gb/ (genuine distinct UK storefront, GBP pricing). Access: DataDome-protected; direct HTTP (curl_cffi) and Playwright/CDP both got IP-blocked with a DataDome CAPTCHA page after a handful of requests, so this was completed via Claude-in-Chrome (tier 3) on the user's real Chrome session. Scoped to Home department (Home & Decor + Furniture top-nav departments), excluding Clothing/Dresses/Petite/Shoes/Accessories/Weddings/Beauty. The site-wide /en-gb/new-in page mixes all departments (clothing included) so it was NOT used as a row -- instead each Home-department branch has its own dedicated, department-scoped 'New In' listing reached via that department's own nav/category dropdown: 'Home & Decor' department -> /en-gb/new-home (breadcrumb 'Home & Decor / New In', H1 'New Home & Decor', 331 products) and 'Furniture' department -> /en-gb/new-furniture (breadcrumb 'Furniture / New In', H1 'New Furniture', 46 products), both confirmed as real browsable PLPs with product grids, sort and filters, not marketing/editorial pages. Also present in the sitemap but excluded as out of New-Arrivals scope: /en-gb/new-in-winter-shop (themed seasonal campaign, not a plain 'recently added' listing -- Seasonal is a separate project per this project's conventions), /en-gb/new-in-bottoms and /en-gb/new-in-beauty-wellness (Fashion/Beauty department, out of Home scope), /en-gb/new-this-week and /en-gb/new-in-today (site-wide, all-department, redundant with /en-gb/new-in and not home-scoped). The Home & Decor department's 'New Home & Decor' listing briefly showed department-style quick-filter chips (Candles & Home Fragrance / Home Décor / Kitchen & Dining / Lighting / Soft Furnishings) on one load but these did not resolve to distinct URLs on inspection and were not confirmed as genuine separate PLPs, so no invented sub-rows were created for them -- New Home & Decor is recorded as one flat listing. No genuine New Arrivals sub-structure found under New Furniture either.
